hooks.logic:
Count up "turnInCurrPos".
Let number be the numeric entry "turns_to_move_position" in the battle settings of the group of the enemy.
Let v2 be the count "turnInCurrPos".
If condition flag v is up this frame and number is less than v2, then
  Reset the count "turnInCurrPos".
  Choose state 13 next and stop.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let globalRegister be the script register.
  If the length of list is globalRegister's 'movePosMapIdx' and number is v2, then choose state 14 next and stop.
  The enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move.
